verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub README confirm multi-modal ingestion (PDFs, images with OCR, videos, code) that is uploaded and automatically extracted into memories, plus hybrid/document search and recall APIs to retrieve that content later. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of file/image/PDF recall specifically (community evidence only covers link/content-size issues, not file uploads), and no explicit example of recalling from an uploaded PDF/image in the docs shown.
